title: Update Kinova Robotics release team membership
author: aalmrad
body:
# Updates to kinova_robotics release team membership.

## New team members

* @aalmrad Kinova Robotics [package.xml](https://github.com/Kinovarobotics/ros2_kortex/blob/0a7eb3bd3ed0fcd7c5fff2b0a641a9d1ab4c8083/kortex_moveit_config/kinova_gen3_lite_moveit_config/package.xml#L9)

## Retiring team members

* @felixmaisonneuve [package.xml](https://github.com/Kinovarobotics/ros2_kortex/commit/566c345e7d689612b171940bbe2b446822ffd595)

A [pull request](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/44217) has been created on rosdistro to push a new release for the ros2_kortex packages and it is really important to update the release team members with the minimum delays so I can get write access to the ros2-gbp release repository and continue blooming releases.

I'm referencing the original release team issue and the previously mentioned rosdistro pull request
#https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/issues/291
#https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/44217

comments.author: sloretz
comments.body:
It looks like @aalmrad is now the maintainer in the upstream package.xml https://github.com/Kinovarobotics/ros2_kortex/commit/566c345e7d689612b171940bbe2b446822ffd595 , so they have write access to the source repo

@nuclearsandwich what's the next step of this process to get them right access to the release repo?
